void check(bool condition, String message) {
  if (!condition) throw StateError(message);
}

void checkEventKeepAlive(bool expected) {
  check(_pigeonFfiOnEventCallback.keepIsolateAlive == expected, 'event keep-alive');
  check(_pigeonFfiOnErrorCallback.keepIsolateAlive == expected, 'error keep-alive');
  check(_pigeonFfiOnDoneCallback.keepIsolateAlive == expected, 'done keep-alive');
}

Future<void> main() async {
  final bindings = pigeon_ffi.NativeLibrary(ffi.DynamicLibrary.process());
  final lazy = Api(ffiBindings: bindings, messageChannelSuffix: 'lazy');
  check(pigeon_ffi.NativeLibrary.connectCalls == 0, 'constructor must not connect');
  lazy.pigeonDispose();
  lazy.pigeonDispose();
  check(pigeon_ffi.NativeLibrary.disconnectCalls == 0, 'unused API needs no disconnect');
  final api = Api(ffiBindings: bindings, messageChannelSuffix: 'engine-a');
  final first = api.work();
  final second = api.work();
  final callback = _pigeonFfiReplyCallback.nativeFunction;
  check(_pigeonFfiReplyCallback.keepIsolateAlive, 'pending requests must keep alive');
  bindings.reply(<Object?>[7]);
  check(await first == 7, 'first reply');
  check(_pigeonFfiReplyCallback.keepIsolateAlive, 'second request still pending');
  bindings.reply(<Object?>[9]);
  check(await second == 9, 'second reply');
  check(!_pigeonFfiReplyCallback.keepIsolateAlive, 'requests completed');

  final third = api.work();
  check(_pigeonFfiReplyCallback.nativeFunction == callback, 'callback must be reused');
  check(_pigeonFfiReplyCallback.keepIsolateAlive, 'reused callback must keep alive');
  bindings.reply(<Object?>['native', 'failure', null]);
  try {
    await third;
    throw StateError('Expected native failure.');
  } on PlatformException catch (error) {
    check(error.code == 'native', 'native error must propagate');
  }
  check(!_pigeonFfiReplyCallback.keepIsolateAlive, 'failed reply completed');
  bindings.failStart = true;
  try {
    await api.work();
    throw StateError('Expected startup failure.');
  } on StateError catch (error) {
    check(error.message == 'Cannot start request.', 'startup error must propagate');
  }
  check(!_pigeonFfiReplyCallback.keepIsolateAlive, 'startup failure cleared');

  bindings.failStart = false;
  final independent = Api(ffiBindings: bindings, messageChannelSuffix: 'engine-b');
  final pending = api.work().then<Object>((_) => 'unexpected success', onError: (Object error) => error);
  final survivor = independent.work();
  final firstSession = bindings.replies[0].$1;
  final secondSession = bindings.replies[1].$1;
  check(firstSession != secondSession, 'separate facades need separate sessions');
  check(pigeon_ffi.NativeLibrary.sessions[firstSession] == 'engine-a', 'first registration name');
  check(pigeon_ffi.NativeLibrary.sessions[secondSession] == 'engine-b', 'second registration name');
  api.pigeonDispose();
  api.pigeonDispose();
  check(await pending is StateError, 'dispose must fail owned pending calls');
  check(_pigeonFfiReplyCallback.keepIsolateAlive, 'other owner is still pending');
  bindings.reply(<Object?>[100]); // A callback already queued before disconnect.
  bindings.reply(<Object?>[17]);
  check(await survivor == 17, 'disposing one facade must preserve another');
  check(!_pigeonFfiReplyCallback.keepIsolateAlive, 'disposed callbacks must not keep alive');
  try {
    await api.work();
    throw StateError('Disposed API was reused.');
  } on StateError catch (error) {
    check(error.message == 'This FFI API has been disposed.', 'dispose must reject new calls');
  }
  independent.pigeonDispose();

  // Two wrappers can share the default native registration without sharing
  // ownership of pending requests or of their session lifetimes.
  final sharedFirst = Api(ffiBindings: bindings);
  final sharedSecond = Api(ffiBindings: bindings);
  final sharedPending = sharedFirst.work().then<Object>((_) => 'unexpected success', onError: (Object error) => error);
  final sharedSurvivor = sharedSecond.work();
  final sharedFirstSession = bindings.replies[0].$1;
  final sharedSecondSession = bindings.replies[1].$1;
  check(sharedFirstSession != sharedSecondSession, 'shared registration needs separate sessions');
  check(pigeon_ffi.NativeLibrary.sessions[sharedFirstSession] == '' &&
      pigeon_ffi.NativeLibrary.sessions[sharedSecondSession] == '', 'wrappers must select the same default registration');
  sharedFirst.pigeonDispose();
  check(await sharedPending is StateError, 'shared dispose must fail its own request');
  check(pigeon_ffi.NativeLibrary.sessions.containsKey(sharedSecondSession), 'shared dispose removed another session');
  bindings.reply(<Object?>[100]); // Already posted before the first disconnect.
  bindings.reply(<Object?>[23]);
  check(await sharedSurvivor == 23, 'shared dispose failed another owner request');
  final sharedAgain = sharedSecond.work();
  bindings.reply(<Object?>[24]);
  check(await sharedAgain == 24, 'surviving shared wrapper must accept new calls');
  sharedSecond.pigeonDispose();
  await pigeon_ffi.NativeLibrary.waitForBuffers();
  check(!_pigeonFfiReplyCallback.keepIsolateAlive, 'shared wrappers retained idle callback');
  check(pigeon_ffi.NativeLibrary.sessions.isEmpty, 'shared wrappers leaked native sessions');

  final event = Completer<int>();
  final errors = <Object>[];
  final done = Completer<void>();
  final firstStream = events(instanceName: 'first', messageChannelSuffix: 'engine-a');
  final subscription = firstStream.listen(event.complete, onError: errors.add);
  final other = events(instanceName: 'first', messageChannelSuffix: 'engine-b').listen((_) {}, onDone: done.complete);
  final ids = _pigeonFfiEventControllers.keys.toList();
  checkEventKeepAlive(true);
  check(pigeon_ffi.NativeLibrary.streamSessions[ids.first] != pigeon_ffi.NativeLibrary.streamSessions[ids.last], 'event registrations need distinct sessions');
  final notify = _pigeonFfiOnEventCallback.nativeFunction
      .asFunction<void Function(int, ffi.Pointer<pigeon_ffi.PigeonFfiBuffer>)>();
  notify(ids.first, pigeon_ffi.NativeLibrary.buffer(42));
  check(await event.future == 42, 'event must be delivered');
  notify(ids.first, pigeon_ffi.NativeLibrary.buffer(99));
  await subscription.cancel();
  checkEventKeepAlive(true);
  await pigeon_ffi.NativeLibrary.waitForBuffers();
  check(errors.isEmpty, 'queued canceled event must be ignored');

  _pigeonFfiOnDoneCallback.nativeFunction.asFunction<void Function(int)>()(ids.last);
  await done.future;
  checkEventKeepAlive(false);
  check(_pigeonFfiEventControllers.isEmpty, 'completed stream must cancel native sink');

  // A broadcast stream can be subscribed to again after its last listener cancels.
  final reused = firstStream.listen((_) {});
  checkEventKeepAlive(true);
  final lastId = _pigeonFfiEventControllers.keys.single;
  notify(lastId, pigeon_ffi.NativeLibrary.buffer(100));
  await reused.cancel();
  checkEventKeepAlive(false);
  await pigeon_ffi.NativeLibrary.waitForBuffers();

  final sharedEvent = Completer<int>();
  final sharedEventFirst = events(instanceName: 'shared-first').listen((_) {});
  final sharedEventSecond = events(instanceName: 'shared-second').listen(sharedEvent.complete);
  final sharedEventIds = _pigeonFfiEventControllers.keys.toList();
  check(sharedEventIds.length == 2, 'shared handler needs independent controllers');
  for (final id in sharedEventIds) {
    final session = pigeon_ffi.NativeLibrary.streamSessions[id]!;
    check(pigeon_ffi.NativeLibrary.sessions[session] == '', 'shared event handler must use default registration');
  }
  await sharedEventFirst.cancel();
  checkEventKeepAlive(true);
  notify(sharedEventIds.first, pigeon_ffi.NativeLibrary.buffer(100));
  notify(sharedEventIds.last, pigeon_ffi.NativeLibrary.buffer(25));
  check(await sharedEvent.future == 25, 'shared cancel stopped another event subscription');
  await sharedEventSecond.cancel();
  await pigeon_ffi.NativeLibrary.waitForBuffers();
  checkEventKeepAlive(false);
  check(pigeon_ffi.NativeLibrary.sessions.isEmpty, 'shared event subscriptions leaked sessions');

  pigeon_ffi.NativeLibrary.failListen = true;
  final listenError = Completer<Object>();
  final failed = events().listen((_) {}, onError: listenError.complete);
  check(await listenError.future is PlatformException, 'listen error must propagate');
  checkEventKeepAlive(false);
  await failed.cancel();
  pigeon_ffi.NativeLibrary.failListen = false;

  pigeon_ffi.NativeLibrary.failCancel = true;
  final cancelError = Completer<Object>();
  await runZonedGuarded<Future<void>>(() async {
    final cancelFailure = events().listen((_) {});
    await cancelFailure.cancel();
  }, (error, stackTrace) => cancelError.complete(error));
  check((await cancelError.future as PlatformException).code == 'cancel',
      'broadcast onCancel error must reach the zone');
  checkEventKeepAlive(false);
  check(_pigeonFfiAsyncReplies.isEmpty, 'requests leaked');
  check(_pigeonFfiEventControllers.isEmpty, 'subscriptions leaked');
  check(pigeon_ffi.NativeLibrary.sessions.isEmpty, 'sessions leaked');
  check(pigeon_ffi.NativeLibrary.streamSessions.isEmpty, 'native streams leaked');
  check(pigeon_ffi.NativeLibrary.allocated == pigeon_ffi.NativeLibrary.freed, 'buffers leaked');
  print('All callback lifecycle checks passed.');
}
